about: ENT-S1 licence policy for a product sold BOTH hosted and installed. NOT LEGAL ADVICE: counsel confirms each reading. The names are licence FAMILIES as scripts/licence_audit.py recognises them in a licence field.
written: 2026-10-13, from the backlog story ENT-S1 (FR7) and the Licence Register sheet dated 2026-10-04

rules.ALLOWED: MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0, ISC, PostgreSQL, OFL (fonts only), and our own work. Ship the licence text and any NOTICE.
rules.ALLOWED WITH NOTICES: LGPL, used unmodified and replaceable: ship its licence text and notices; never fold modified LGPL code into our own files.
rules.NOT IN POLICY: A licence the policy does not name (MPL, PSF, HPND, Unlicense, custom terms, ...). Blocked until a decision is recorded with what, who and when.
rules.REVIEW: GPL, AGPL, SSPL, RSAL, non-commercial, research-only, proprietary or gated licences. Blocked until a decision is recorded. AGPL tools are never bundled: a separate process only, after counsel's review. Banned in the default install: AGPL or GPL linked into our code, SSPL, non-commercial, research-only, custom gated licences.
rules.UNKNOWN: No licence evidence. Never guessed. Blocked until the licence is read from the source and recorded.

installed_version: ship the NOTICE file and every third-party licence text
make a source offer wherever a copyleft component is shipped
redistribute NVIDIA libraries only as the EULA's redistributable list allows (licences/nvidia_redistributable.json)
for every Qwen model under the Qwen LICENSE AGREEMENT: the agreement, the notice line, and 'Built with Qwen' where we train or improve a distributed model
